+import pytest

+        handle_rename_user({"id": "2", "name": "Linus Torvalds"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_trims_whitespace():
+    try:
+        status, user = handle_rename_user({"id": "3", "name": "  Grace H.  "})
+        assert status == 200
+        assert user["name"] == "Grace H."
+        assert handle_get_user({"id": "3"})[1]["name"] == "Grace H."

+        handle_rename_user({"id": "3", "name": "Grace Hopper"})

+    finally:
+        handle_rename_user({"id": "1", "name": "Ada Lovelace"})
+
